## Description
A clear and concise description of what this pull request changes and why.

## Related issue
Closes #(issue number), if applicable.

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Content / image update
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactor / cleanup

## How has this been tested?
Describe how you ran the site (`npm run dev` or `npm run build` + `npm run preview`) and which pages you checked (Home, Collections, About, Contact, search overlay, mobile menu, smooth scrolling and animations, responsive layout).

## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run build` completes without errors
- [ ] Every affected page renders correctly under the `/nk-creations/` base path (`npm run preview`)
- [ ] Hash navigation, search overlay and mobile menu work
- [ ] No console errors in the browser
- [ ] I have updated documentation where needed
